[Verse 1]
I walked into the kitchen with a reason in my head
Saw a message on my phone and watched a video instead
Then I see something that I’ve never seen
Now I need to buy a fax machine

Now I remember, I need to pay a parking fine
Forty-seven minutes later I’m researching Roman wine
I see a woman baking Italian bread
And a quiz that claims to know which kind of sandwich lives inside my head

Cheese.
Probably cheese.

[Pre-Chorus]
I only need a minute, I only need a sec
I only need one more thing I need to check !

[Chorus]
EVERYTHING! EVERYWHERE! ALL AT ONCE!
My brain’s doing cartwheels at the digital lunch!
Swipe to the left!
Swipe to the right!
Lose half an hour in the middle of the night!
EVERYTHING! EVERYWHERE! GIVE IT TO ME NOW!
3 hours have disappeared and I don’t know HOW!
Little bits of everything eating up my soul!
One more little video, then I’ll take control!

[Verse 2]
I meant to write, I meant to think,
I poured some coffee, took a drink,
Then somebody posted a dancing bear,
And somehow now I’m shopping for a folding chair.

(Pre-Chorus)
Click it!
Skip it!

I only need a minute, I only need a sec

(Chorus)
EVERYTHING! EVERYWHERE! ALL AT ONCE!

Swipe to the left!
Swipe to the right!
Lose half an hour in the middle of the night!
EVERYTHING! EVERYWHERE! GIVE IT TO ME NOW!
3 hours have disappeared and I don’t know HOW!

(Bridge)
A Dog on a skateboard!
A Cat in a dress.
My mind has several squirrels
And they’re making a mess!

I came here for an answer,

I lost my train of thought
And it’s travelling first class!

(Breakdown)

Maybe I’ll put the phone away.

(Gentle guitar chord.)

Sit quietly.

(Final Chorus)
EVERYTHING! EVERYWHERE! ALL AT ONCE!

Swipe to the right!
I’ve been going nowhere at the speed of light!
EVERYTHING! EVERYWHERE! GIVE IT TO ME NOW!
